description: A bright apartment two minutes from Calangute beach, with a shared pool and a balcony that catches the evening breeze. Good for couples and small families who want the sand close by.
extraInfo: Beach towels provided. Quiet hours after 11 pm.

description: A cottage inside a working coffee estate, with a verandah looking straight into the plantation. Trails to Mullayanagiri start close by.
extraInfo: Estate tour included. Mobile signal can be patchy.

description: A wooden cottage in Old Manali looking onto an apple orchard, with a balcony over the Beas river valley. Cafes and the market are a short walk downhill.
extraInfo: Room heater provided. Parking is on the main road.

description: A relaxed room on the East Coast Road with sea air and a rooftop that fills up at sunset. A short drive from the beach and the shore temples.
extraInfo: Rooftop open till 10 pm.

description: A serviced suite in Indiranagar with a workspace and fast wifi, built for people in the city for work. Cafes, metro and the pub street are all within walking distance.
extraInfo: Self check-in with a lockbox.

description: A restored Portuguese villa in old Panjim, with high ceilings, tiled floors and a shaded courtyard. Walk to the Latin Quarter and the riverside in ten minutes.
extraInfo: Breakfast can be arranged on request.

description: A cheerful cottage above Kodaikanal lake with big windows and a garden that catches the morning sun. Easy walking distance to the boat house.
extraInfo: Bonfire can be arranged in the garden.

description: A calm villa on the Alleppey backwaters with its own sit-out over the water. Houseboats drift past all day and the sunsets are the main event.
extraInfo: Canoe available free of charge.

description: A colonial style estate house in Ooty with a fireplace, a long lawn and old trees around it. Quiet, spacious and made for slow mornings.
extraInfo: Firewood provided. Pets allowed on request.

description: A large suite in central Kolkata with tall windows and colonial era furniture. Park Street and the Maidan are both within walking distance.
extraInfo: Airport pickup available on request.

description: A working cardamom farm stay surrounded by tea slopes, with a wood fireplace for cold evenings. Wake up to mist over the valley and fresh filter coffee.
extraInfo: Farm walk included. Carry warm clothes, nights get cold.

description: A suite in a restored haveli near the old city, with jharokha windows and hand painted arches. Hawa Mahal and the bazaars are a short auto ride away.
extraInfo: Rooftop breakfast available.

description: A breezy villa near Somnath with a coconut grove between the house and the sea. Simple, quiet and a few minutes from the temple.
extraInfo: Vegetarian kitchen only.

description: A traditional Ladakhi lodge in Leh with thick walls, warm bedding and a sun room for the afternoons. Good starting point for Pangong and Nubra trips.
extraInfo: Take the first day easy to adjust to the altitude.

description: A boutique resort on the Kedarnath trekking route with river facing rooms and a warm dining hall. A practical, comfortable base before the climb.
extraInfo: Guide can be arranged. Hot water in fixed hours.

description: A quiet two bedroom home in Koregaon Park with a walled garden and plenty of shade. Cafes and the river path are close by.
extraInfo: Garden is shared with the owner's family.

description: A modern two bedroom apartment on the eighteenth floor with a gym and rooftop pool in the building. Handy for the tech parks and the airport road.
extraInfo: Lift access. Building has 24 hour security.

description: A cliff top house above Anjuna with a wide sea view deck and a small private pool. The famous flea market is a ten minute walk down the lane.
extraInfo: Steep steps to the entrance. Not ideal for very young children.

description: A wooden villa a few steps from quiet Palolem beach in south Goa, with hammocks on the porch. Calm, warm and good for a slow week by the sea.
extraInfo: Kayaks available. Beach is a two minute walk.

description: A large bungalow in leafy Assagao with a mango tree courtyard and an outdoor dining table. Built for groups who want space and quiet between beach days.
extraInfo: Cook can be arranged for an extra charge.

description: A heritage home in Fort Kochi with antique wooden furniture and a shaded inner courtyard. The Chinese fishing nets and the cafes are a short stroll away.
extraInfo: Filter coffee and breakfast included.

description: A raised cabin among the trees in Wayanad, with a glass front looking into the forest canopy. Birdsong in the morning and complete quiet at night.
extraInfo: Torch provided. Paths are unlit after dark.

description: A simple flat on the hill above Kovalam beach, with a balcony facing the lighthouse. Easy walk down to the sand and the seafood places.
extraInfo: Third floor, no lift.

description: A planter's bungalow set inside a coffee and pepper estate in Coorg, with a long verandah and a fireplace. Waterfalls and viewpoints are a short drive away.
extraInfo: Estate walk with the caretaker included.

description: A small cottage across the river from Hampi, looking out at the boulder fields and paddy. Cycles at the gate for getting to the ruins.
extraInfo: River crossing by boat until 6 pm only.

description: A bright studio in the French quarter with shuttered windows and bougainvillea over the gate. Promenade beach and the bakeries are around the corner.
extraInfo: Bicycles available for guests.

description: A hillside cottage above Yercaud lake surrounded by coffee and orange trees. Cool through the year with a garden made for long breakfasts.
extraInfo: Bonfire on request. Roads are winding, drive slowly.

description: A pine cabin right on the Parvati river in Kasol, close enough to hear the water all night. Trails to Kheerganga start from the village.
extraInfo: Heater provided. Carry cash, ATMs are limited.

description: A lodge at the Bir landing site where you can watch gliders come down over breakfast. Simple warm rooms and a sunny common terrace.
extraInfo: Paragliding booking help available at the desk.

description: A stone cottage on the ridge above Shimla with deodar trees around it and a fireplace inside. Mall Road is a fifteen minute walk downhill.
extraInfo: Parking is at the road, a short walk from the house.

description: A traditional mud brick house in Kaza with thick warm walls and a courtyard facing the mountains. Very basic, very quiet, and the night sky is extraordinary.
extraInfo: Electricity is limited in the evenings. High altitude, rest on arrival.
